_comment: Site-wide pop-up shown when someone opens the site. active:true shows it, false hides it. Change 'id' whenever you post a NEW message so people who dismissed the last one see the new one. frequency: 'once' = shown a single time per visitor (normal news); 'always' = shown every visit (emergencies only). eyebrow/linkUrl/linkLabel are optional; leave linkUrl empty for no button.
